author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (scalar gate + post-norm, BiGRU=160) — tri-seed (seed=42)
abstract: Completes the tri-seed replication for the current best config: Conv+Pooling (mean↔LSE τ=0.25, len-normalized) + BiGRU(160), scalar-gated fusion with post-fusion LayerNorm. This run uses BASE_SEED=42 to verify stability across seeds.
